findings.problem: The hint 'polite wish' doesn't rule out 'ich hätte gern', a very common German way to say 'I would like' (Ich hätte gern einen Kaffee), so the prompt has two right answers.
findings.fix: hint: polite wish, the modal verb möchten, not hätte gern

note: Möchten has no Perfekt of its own, since hat gemocht means 'liked' (from mögen) and a past wish is usually said with wollte, so the editor may want to say that the Perfekt shown is borrowed from mögen; the sibling cards should get the same hätte gern fix.
